en.name: Sauron
en.ability: At the end of each day, publicly choose a player: they die. All players know who you are. You die if & only if there are no living Minions.

revisions.v1: At the end of each day, publicly choose a player: they die. All players know who you are. You die if & only if there are no living Minions.

en.flavor: Concealed within his fortress, the Lord of Mordor sees all. His gaze pierces cloud, shadow, earth, and flesh.
